cause_quote: The new `.chat-main__conversation--details` rule added `padding-top: calc(var(--chat-mobile-pane-header-height, 0px) + 50px);`, reducing the content height used to size the footer.
user_saw: The question footer was sized incorrectly in landscape chat when the Details control was enabled.
summary: The fix moves the Details header spacing to a top margin on the transcript viewport, preserving the footer’s sizing while keeping transcript actions clear of the header.
reasoning: The causing commit’s parent already had the Details control, landscape question-footer coverage, and footer sizing rules based on the unpadded `chat-conversation` container. The causing diff added padding to that container, shrinking the content box measured by the existing height query and `cqh` units.
